question: 2026年2月退款金额最高的3笔成功退款，退款单号和金额是多少？
sql: SELECT refund_no, refund_amount FROM trd_refund WHERE refund_status = 'SUCCESS' AND refunded_at >= '2026-02-01' AND refunded_at < '2026-03-01' ORDER BY refund_amount DESC LIMIT 3

question: 2026年2月的GMV是多少？
sql: SELECT SUM(o.total_amount + o.freight_amount) AS gmv FROM trd_order o WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-02-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-03-01'

question: 2026年2月不同支付方式（在线支付、货到付款、分期）的支付订单数各是多少？
sql: SELECT pay_type, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM trd_order WHERE paid_at >= '2026-02-01' AND paid_at < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY pay_type

question: 2026年2月每天的UV是多少？
sql: SELECT stat_date, SUM(uv) AS uv FROM mkt_traffic_daily WHERE stat_date >= '2026-02-01' AND stat_date < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date

question: 2026年2月下单的订单里，各订单状态分别有多少单？
sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM trd_order WHERE created_at >= '2026-02-01' AND created_at < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY order_status

question: 2026年2月数码家电类目下销售额最高的3个品牌是哪些？
sql: SELECT b.name, SUM(i.pay_share) AS sales FROM trd_order_item i JOIN trd_order o ON i.order_id = o.id JOIN prd_category c3 ON i.category_id = c3.id JOIN prd_category c2 ON c3.parent_id = c2.id JOIN prd_category c1 ON c2.parent_id = c1.id JOIN prd_brand b ON i.brand_id = b.id WHERE c1.name = '数码家电' AND o.order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED','CLOSED') AND o.paid_at >= '2026-02-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 3

question: 2026年2月数码家电类目的销售额是多少？
sql: SELECT SUM(i.pay_share) AS sales FROM trd_order_item i JOIN trd_order o ON i.order_id = o.id JOIN prd_category c3 ON i.category_id = c3.id JOIN prd_category c2 ON c3.parent_id = c2.id JOIN prd_category c1 ON c2.parent_id = c1.id WHERE c1.name = '数码家电' AND o.order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED','CLOSED') AND o.paid_at >= '2026-02-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-03-01'

question: 2026年2月自有品牌和非自有品牌的销售额各是多少？
sql: SELECT b.is_own, SUM(i.pay_share) AS sales FROM trd_order_item i JOIN trd_order o ON i.order_id = o.id JOIN prd_brand b ON i.brand_id = b.id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED','CLOSED') AND o.paid_at >= '2026-02-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY b.is_own

question: 2026年8月华东中心仓每天的可用库存总量是多少？
sql: SELECT sn.snapshot_date, SUM(sn.available_qty) AS available_qty FROM wms_inventory_snapshot sn JOIN wms_warehouse w ON sn.warehouse_id = w.id WHERE w.name = '华东中心仓' AND sn.snapshot_date >= '2026-08-01' AND sn.snapshot_date < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY sn.snapshot_date ORDER BY sn.snapshot_date

question: 2026年2月华东各省份的GMV是多少？
sql: SELECT r.province, SUM(o.total_amount + o.freight_amount) AS gmv FROM trd_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON o.shop_id = s.id JOIN dim_region r ON s.region_id = r.id WHERE r.big_region = '华东' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-02-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY r.province

question: 2026年2月各大区的GMV分别是多少？ GMV最高的那个大区里，排名前2的店铺是哪些？
sql: SELECT s.name, SUM(o.total_amount + o.freight_amount) AS gmv FROM trd_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON o.shop_id = s.id JOIN dim_region r ON s.region_id = r.id WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-02-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-03-01' AND r.big_region = (SELECT r2.big_region FROM trd_order o2 JOIN dim_shop s2 ON o2.shop_id = s2.id JOIN dim_region r2 ON s2.region_id = r2.id WHERE o2.paid_at >= '2026-02-01' AND o2.paid_at < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY r2.big_region ORDER BY SUM(o2.total_amount + o2.freight_amount) DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 2

question: 2026年2月的实付金额是多少？ 其中华东是多少？
sql: SELECT SUM(o.pay_amount) AS pay_amount FROM trd_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON o.shop_id = s.id JOIN dim_region r ON s.region_id = r.id WHERE r.big_region = '华东' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-02-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-03-01'

question: 2026年2月自营商城平台的GMV是多少？ 环比上个月变化了多少？
sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.paid_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(o.total_amount + o.freight_amount) AS gmv FROM trd_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON o.shop_id = s.id JOIN dim_platform p ON s.platform_id = p.id WHERE p.name = '自营商城' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-01-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY month

question: 2026年2月顺丰的运单量是多少？ 每天的运单量走势呢？
sql: SELECT DATE(t.shipped_at) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tms_shipment t JOIN tms_carrier c ON t.carrier_id = c.id WHERE c.name = '顺丰' AND t.shipped_at >= '2026-02-01' AND t.shipped_at < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

question: 2026年2月华南的GMV是多少？ 按省份拆一下
sql: SELECT r.province, SUM(o.total_amount + o.freight_amount) AS gmv FROM trd_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON o.shop_id = s.id JOIN dim_region r ON s.region_id = r.id WHERE r.big_region = '华南' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-02-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-03-01' GROUP BY r.province

question: 2026年2月华东的GMV和去年同期相比变化了多少？从一级类目和平台两个维度分析原因
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-02-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-03-01' THEN o.total_amount + o.freight_amount END) / SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2025-02-01' AND o.paid_at < '2025-03-01' THEN o.total_amount + o.freight_amount END) - 1 FROM trd_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON o.shop_id = s.id JOIN dim_region r ON s.region_id = r.id WHERE r.big_region = '华东'
